## About
United Speedometer & Electrical works on the parts of a car most shops would rather not touch: instrument clusters, speedometers, gauges and the wiring behind them. We have served the greater Houston area for a long time, and our tools have kept up with newer model vehicles and today's smart cars.
We haven't forgotten the older cars either. We still service mechanical instrumentation and electrical on antiques and classics, so whether it's your first car or your last, come by and see us.
You'll find us at 5335 Bingle Rd in Houston. Google reviewers give us a 4 star rating across 54 reviews.

## Services
- Instrumentation repairs and exchanges: Speedometers, gauges and instrument clusters that are erratic or have stopped working.
- Electrical diagnostics and repairs: For electrical problems you can't pin down, no-starts and warning lights on the dash.
- Accuracy checks and calibrations: Making sure your speedometer and gauges read correctly.
- Odometer corrections: An affidavit to correct odometer form is available with our service forms.
- Reflashing and reprogramming of GM, Ford and Chrysler modules
- Custom speedometer cables and housings
- Fleet services: Safety strobes, beacons, back-up rear view monitors, park aid systems and back up alarms.
- Antique and classic servicing: Instrumentation and electrical work on older cars.

## FAQ
Q: Is there a diagnostic fee?
A: Yes. The $75 diagnostic fee is paid in advance, and it may be applied to recommended repairs or replacements. If you're unsure, ask a customer service representative before you pay.

Q: How can I pay?
A: Retail customers can pay with cash or credit/debit card. Personal checks are not accepted. If you'd like to pay online, include your email address on the service request form.

Q: Do I need a form when I drop off or ship instrumentation?
A: Yes. A service request form or written service request order tells us your vehicle information and the specific problem, so nothing gets misunderstood. You can bring instrumentation in over the counter or ship it to us.
